passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى عَظِيمِ نَعْمَائِهِ، وَجَزِيلِ فَضْلِهِ وَآلَائِهِ، وَصَلَّى اللهُ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى خَاتَمِ أَنْبِيَائِهِ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَتَابِعِيهِم مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِهِ.
passages.tr: Bismillâhir-rahmânir-rahîm. Al-hamdu lillâhi `alâ `azhîmi na`mâ'ih, wa jazîli fadhlihi wa âlâ'ih, wa shallallâhu wa sallama `alâ khâtami anbiyâ'ihi wa âlihi wa shahbihi wa tâbi`îhim min auliyâ'ih.
passages.id_: Dengan nama Allah Yang Maha Pengasih lagi Maha Penyayang. Segala puji bagi Allah atas nikmat-nikmat-Nya yang agung serta karunia dan anugerah-Nya yang melimpah. Shalawat dan salam Allah atas penutup para nabi-Nya, beserta keluarga dan para sahabat beliau, serta para wali-Nya yang mengikuti mereka.
passages.en: In the Name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. All praise be to Allah for His immense blessings, abundant grace and favours. Peace and blessings be upon the Seal of His Prophets, and upon his Family and Companions, and His saints who follow them.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: وَبَعْدُ؛ فَإِنَّ مِنْ أَعْظَمِ المَوَائِدِ المَبْسُوطَةِ، وَأَشْرَفِ الجَوَاهِرِ المَسْمُوطَةِ لِهَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ هُوَ الوَفَادَةُ عَلَى نَبِيِّهَا العَظِيمِ، صَاحِبِ الحَوْضِ وَاللِّوَاءِ. فَكَمْ وَقَفَ بِبَابِهِ مُذْنِبٌ مُقَصِّرٌ فَخَرَجَ بِخِلْعَةِ الوِلَايَةِ، فَهُوَ بَابُ الكَرَمِ وَالجُودِ، وَالعَطَاءِ المَمْدُودِ.
passages.tr: Wa ba`d; fa'inna min a`zhamil-mawâ'idil-mabsûthah, wa asyrafil-jawâhiril-masmûthati lihâdzihil-ummati huwal-wafâdatu `alâ nabiyyihal-`azhîm, shâhibil-haudhi wal-liwâ'. Fakam waqafa bibâbihi mudznibun muqashshirun fakharaja bikhil`atil-wilâyah, fahuwa bâbul-karami wal-jûd, wal-`athâ'il-mamdûd.
passages.id_: Selanjutnya: sesungguhnya di antara hidangan terbesar yang terhampar dan permata termulia yang teruntai bagi umat ini adalah berkunjung kepada nabinya yang agung, pemilik telaga dan panji. Betapa banyak pendosa yang lalai berdiri di pintunya lalu pulang dengan menyandang jubah kewalian, karena beliaulah pintu kemurahan dan kedermawanan serta pemberian yang tiada putus.
passages.en: To proceed: one of the greatest and most magnificent treasures granted to this nation is the privilege of visiting their great Prophet, the owner of the Pool (Hawd) and the Banner (Liwa). How many a negligent sinner stood at his door and left with the robe of sainthood, for he is the gate of generosity, and a source of endless charity!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: فَيَا صَاحِبَ الذُّنُوبِ، وَيَا كَثِيرَ العُيُوبِ، وَيَا رَاغِبًا فِي المَرَاتِبِ وَطَالِبًا لِلدَّرَجَاتِ، أَقْبِلْ عَلَى الزِّيَارَةِ، وَحُثَّ السَّيْرَ لِنَيْلِ البِشَارَةِ. وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّكَ لَوْ جِئْتَهُ مِنْ آخِرِ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى عَيْنَيْكَ، لَمَا وَفَّيْتَهُ ذَرَّةً مِنْ حَقِّهِ عَلَيْكَ.
passages.tr: Fayâ shâhibadz-dzunûb, wa yâ katsîral-`uyûb, wa yâ râghiban fil-marâtibi wa thâliban lid-darajât, aqbil `alaz-ziyârah, wa hutstsas-sayra linaylil-bisyârah. Wa`lam annaka lau ji'tahu min âkhirid-dunyâ `alâ `aynayk, lamâ waffaytahu dzarratan min haqqihi `alayk.
passages.id_: Maka wahai pemikul dosa, wahai yang banyak aib, wahai yang mendambakan martabat dan mencari derajat yang tinggi, bersegeralah berziarah dan percepatlah perjalanan untuk meraih kabar gembira. Dan ketahuilah, seandainya engkau mendatanginya dari ujung dunia dengan merangkak di atas kedua matamu, engkau tetap belum menunaikan sebutir zarah pun dari haknya atas dirimu.
passages.en: O you who are burdened with sins and many flaws, O you who desire high ranks and aspire to lofty stations, come forward to visit him. Hurry to receive glad tidings. And know that even if you were to come to him from the farthest reaches of the earth, crawling on your eyes, you would still not fulfill even an atom of the rights he has over you.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar:
فَإِذَا دَخَلْتَ المَدِينَةَ المُنَوَّرَةَ:
- فَاغْتَسِلْ وَتَطَيَّبْ بِأَفْضَلِ مَا عِنْدَكَ، وَالْبَسْ أَنْظَفَ وَأَجْمَلَ ثِيَابَكَ.
- ثُمَّ اقْصُدِ المَسْجِدَ النَّبَوِيَّ الشَّرِيفَ وَصَلِّ التَّحِيَّةَ، وَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ فِي الرَّوْضَةِ فَهُوَ أَفْضَلُ.
- ثُمَّ تَوَجَّهْ إِلَى تُجَاهِ الوَجْهِ الطَّاهِرِ، أَمَامَ الشُّبَّاكِ العَاطِرِ.
- وَقِفْ بِأَدَبٍ وَإِجْلَالٍ وَهَيْبَةٍ وَحَيَاءٍ، اسْتَشْعِرْ رَوْحَانِيَّتَهُ الشَّرِيفَةَ ﷺ وَتَمَثَّلْ شَخْصَهُ الشَّرِيفَ أَمَامَكَ.
- وَأَلْقِ التَّحِيَّةَ وَالسَّلَامَ عَلَى خَيْرِ الأَنَامِ ﷺ، وَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ حَيٌّ فِي قَبْرِهِ يَرُدُّ عَلَيْكَ السَّلَامَ.
- ثُمَّ سَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ وَسَيِّدِنَا عُمَرَ الفَارُوقِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُمَا.
- ثُمَّ تَوَجَّهْ إِلَى البَقِيعِ وَاقْصِدْ قَبْرَ السَّيِّدَةِ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا فَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهَا وَزَوْجِهَا وَوَلَدَيْهَا وَبَقِيَّةِ صَحَابَةِ رَسُولِ اللهِ بِالبَقِيعِ، وَادْعُ بِمَا شِئْتَ.
- وَعَلَيْكَ بِتَتَبُّعِ آثَارِ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الكِرَامِ كَمَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ، وَمَسْجِدِ القِبْلَتَيْنِ، وَشُهَدَاءِ أُحُدٍ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ.
passages.tr: Fa'idzâ dakhaltal-madînatal-munawwarah: faghtasil wa tathayyab bi'afdhali mâ `indak, walbas anzhafa wa ajmala tsiyâbak. Tsummaqshudil-masjidan-nabawiyyasy-syarîfa wa shallit-tahiyyah, wa inistatha`ta fir-raudhati fahuwa afdhal. Tsumma tawajjah ilâ tujâhil-wajhith-thâhir, amâmasy-syubbâkil-`âthir. Wa qif bi'adabin wa ijlâlin wa haybatin wa hayâ', istasy`ir rûhâniyyatahusy-syarîfata ﷺ wa tamatstsal syakhshahusy-syarîfa amâmak. Wa alqit-tahiyyata was-salâma `alâ khayril-anâmi ﷺ, wa`lam annahu hayyun fî qabrihi yaruddu `alaykas-salâm. Tsumma sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Abî Bakrinish-shiddîqi wa sayyidinâ `Umaral-fârûqi radhiyallâhu `anhumâ. Tsumma tawajjah ilal-baqî`i waqshid qabras-sayyidati Fâthimataz-zahrâ'i radhiyallâhu `anhâ fasallim `alayhâ wa zaujihâ wa waladayhâ wa baqiyyati shahâbati Rasûlillâhi bil-baqî`, wad`u bimâ syi't. Wa `alayka bitatabbu`i âtsâri Rasûlillâhi shallallâhu `alayhi wa âlihi wa sallama wa ash-hâbihil-kirâmi kamasjidi Qubâ', wa masjidil-qiblatayn, wa syuhadâ'i Uhud, wa ghayri dzâlik.
passages.id_:
Apabila engkau memasuki kota Madinah yang bercahaya:
- Mandilah dan pakailah wewangian terbaik yang engkau miliki, serta kenakanlah pakaianmu yang paling bersih dan paling indah.
- Kemudian menujulah ke Masjid Nabawi yang mulia dan shalatlah tahiyyatul masjid; jika mampu, lakukanlah di Raudhah karena itu lebih utama.
- Kemudian menghadaplah ke arah wajah beliau yang suci, di depan jendela makam yang harum.
- Berdirilah dengan adab, penuh pengagungan, wibawa, dan rasa malu; rasakanlah kehadiran ruhani beliau yang mulia ﷺ dan bayangkanlah sosok beliau yang mulia di hadapanmu.
- Sampaikanlah penghormatan dan salam kepada sebaik-baik makhluk ﷺ, dan ketahuilah bahwa beliau hidup di dalam kuburnya dan menjawab salammu.
- Kemudian ucapkanlah salam kepada junjungan kami Abu Bakar ash-Shiddiq dan junjungan kami Umar al-Faruq, semoga Allah meridhai keduanya.
- Kemudian menujulah ke Baqi dan datangilah makam Sayyidah Fatimah az-Zahra, semoga Allah meridhainya; ucapkanlah salam kepadanya, kepada suaminya, kedua putranya, dan para sahabat Rasulullah lainnya di Baqi, lalu berdoalah sekehendakmu.
- Hendaklah engkau menapaktilasi jejak-jejak Rasulullah ﷺ dan para sahabat beliau yang mulia, seperti Masjid Quba, Masjid Qiblatain, makam para syuhada Uhud, dan tempat-tempat lainnya.
passages.en:
When you enter the illuminated city of Madinah:
- Make yourself as presentable as possible: take a ritual bath (ghusl), apply the finest perfume you have, and wear your cleanest and most elegant clothes.
- Then make your way to the noble Prophet's mosque and perform the prayer of greeting the mosque (tahiyyatul-masjid). If possible, perform it in the Rawdah, as that is even better.
- Then head towards the direction of the Pure Countenance, in front of the perfumed chamber.
- Stand with respect, reverence, awe and shyness. Be aware of his exalted spiritual presence ﷺ, and visualise his noble person before you.
- Offer salutations and greetings to the Best of Creation ﷺ, and know that he is alive in his grave, responding to your greetings.
- Afterward, greet our master Abu Bakr as-Siddiq and our master Umar al-Faruq, may Allah be pleased with them both.
- Thereafter, head towards al-Baqi. Go to the grave of Sayyidatuna Fatimah az-Zahra, may Allah be pleased with her, and greet her, her husband and her children and the rest of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah in al-Baqi, and supplicate as you wish.
- You should retrace the footsteps of the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him and his Family) and his noble Companions, by visiting places such as Masjid Quba, Masjid Qiblatayn, the Martyrs of Uhud, and other sites.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.id_: Salam kepada Rasulullah ﷺ
passages.en: Greeting the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ (ثَلَاثًا).
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullâhi wa barakâtuh (3x).
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai Nabi, beserta rahmat Allah dan berkah-Nya! (tiga kali)
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy and blessings of Allah! (three times)

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا مُحَمَّدُ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا أَحْمَدُ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ nabiyyallâh. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ Rasûlallâh. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ habîballâh. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ Muhammad. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ Ahmad.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai Nabi Allah. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai Rasulullah. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai kekasih Allah. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Muhammad. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Ahmad.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah! Salutations and peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah! Salutations and peace be upon you, O Beloved of Allah! Salutations and peace be upon you, O my master Muhammad! Salutations and peace be upon you, O my master Ahmad!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا أَبَا القَاسِمِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا أَبَا الزَّهْرَاءِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدَ المُرْسَلِينَ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّينَ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ Abal-Qâsim. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ Abaz-Zahrâ'. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidal-mursalîn. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ khâtaman-nabiyyîn.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Abul Qasim. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai ayahanda az-Zahra. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai penghulu para rasul. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai penutup para nabi.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, O my master Abul-Qasim! Salutations and peace be upon you, O my master Abuz-Zahra! Salutations and peace be upon you, O Master of all the Messengers! Salutations and peace be upon you, O Seal of the Prophets!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نُورَ اللهِ الأَكْبَرِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نُورَ الأَنْوَارِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا سِرَّ الأَسْرَارِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا رُوحَ الأَرْوَاحِ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ nûrallâhil-akbar. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ nûral-anwâr. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ sirral-asrâr. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ rûhal-arwâh.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai cahaya Allah yang paling agung. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai cahaya segala cahaya. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai rahasia segala rahasia. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai ruh segala ruh.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O greatest light of Allah! Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O light of all lights! Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O secret of all secrets! Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O spirit of spirits!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا كَهْفَنَا وَكَنَفَنَا. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا شَفِيعَنَا فِي الدَّارَيْنِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا مَلَاذَنَا فِي الحَيَاتَيْنِ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا غَوْثَ المَلْهُوفِينَ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا أَمَانَ الخَائِفِينَ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ kahfanâ wa kanafanâ. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ syafî`anâ fid-dârayn. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ malâdzanâ fil-hayâtayn. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ ghautsal-malhûfîn. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ amânal-khâ'ifîn.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai gua perlindungan dan naungan kami. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai pemberi syafaat kami di dunia dan akhirat. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai tempat berlindung kami di dua kehidupan. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai penolong orang-orang yang menderita. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai pengaman orang-orang yang ketakutan.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O our refuge and our shelter! Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O our intercessor in this world and the next! Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O our recourse in both lives! Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O aid of the desperate! Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O safety of those who are afraid!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى إِخْوَانِكَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، وَآلِ كُلٍّ مِنْهُمْ وَأَصْحَابِهِمْ وَالتَّابِعِينَ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka wa `alâ ikhwânika minan-nabiyyîna wal-mursalîn, wa âli kullin minhum wa ash-hâbihim wat-tâbi`în.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu dan atas saudara-saudaramu dari kalangan para nabi dan rasul, beserta keluarga masing-masing, para sahabat, dan para pengikut mereka.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you and upon your brethren among the Prophets and Messengers, and their families, companions, and followers!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي.. وَعَلَى جِبْرِيلَ وَمِيكَائِيلَ وَإِسْرَافِيلَ وَحَمَلَةِ العَرْشِ وَالكَرُوبِيِّينَ، وَجَمِيعِ المَلَائِكَةِ المُقَرَّبِينَ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî.. wa `alâ Jibrîla wa Mîkâ'îla wa Isrâfîla wa hamalatil-`arsyi wal-karûbiyyîn, wa jamî`il-malâ'ikatil-muqarrabîn.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, dan atas Jibril, Mikail, Israfil, para malaikat pemikul Arasy, para karubiyyin, dan seluruh malaikat yang didekatkan.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, and upon Jibril, Mika'il, Israfil, the bearers of the Throne, the archangels, and all the angels brought nigh!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَعَلَى سَيِّدَتِنَا خَدِيجَةَ الكُبْرَى، وَفَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَا، وَعَائِشَةَ الرِّضَا.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî wa `alâ sayyidatinâ Khadîjatal-kubrâ, wa Fâthimataz-zahrâ, wa `Â'isyatar-ridhâ.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, dan atas junjungan kami Sayyidah Khadijah al-Kubra, Fatimah az-Zahra, dan Aisyah ar-Ridha.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, O my master, and upon Sayyidatuna Khadijah al-Kubra, Fatimah az-Zahra, and A'ishah ar-Rida!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَعَلَى بَنِيكَ القَاسِمِ وَعَبْدِ اللهِ الطَّيِّبِ الطَّاهِرِ وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَنَاتِكَ. الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَعَلَى بَنَاتِكَ الطَّاهِرَاتِ زَيْنَبَ وَرُقَيَّةَ وَأُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî wa `alâ banîkal-Qâsimi wa `Abdillâhith-thayyibith-thâhiri wa Ibrâhîma wa banâtik. Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî wa `alâ banâtikath-thâhirâti Zaynaba wa Ruqayyata wa Ummi Kultsûm.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, dan atas putra-putramu: al-Qasim, Abdullah ath-Thayyib ath-Thahir, dan Ibrahim, serta putri-putrimu. Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, dan atas putri-putrimu yang suci: Zainab, Ruqayyah, dan Ummu Kultsum.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, and upon your sons al-Qasim, Abdullah at-Tayyib at-Tahir, and Ibrahim, and your daughters! Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, and upon your pure daughters Zaynab, Ruqayyah and Umm Kulthum!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَعَلَى أُمَّهَاتِ المُؤْمِنِينَ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî wa `alâ ummahâtil-mu'minîn.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, dan atas para ibunda kaum mukminin.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, and upon the Mothers of the Believers!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي وَعَلَى سَادَاتِنَا أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، وَعُمَرَ الفَارُوقِ، وَذِي النُّورَيْنِ عُثْمَانَ، وَبَابِ مَدِينَةِ العِلْمِ الإِمَامِ عَلِيٍّ، وَعَلَى المُهَاجِرِينَ وَالأَنْصَارِ، وَالصَّحَابَةِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî wa `alâ sâdâtinâ Abî Bakrinish-shiddîq, wa `Umaral-fârûq, wa dzin-nûrayni `Utsmân, wa bâbi madînatil-`ilmil-imâmi `Aliyy, wa `alal-muhâjirîna wal-anshâr, wash-shahâbati ajma`în.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, dan atas para penghulu kami: Abu Bakar ash-Shiddiq, Umar al-Faruq, Utsman sang pemilik dua cahaya, dan pintu kota ilmu Imam Ali, serta atas kaum Muhajirin dan Anshar dan segenap sahabat.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, O our master, and upon my masters Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (the utterly truthful), Umar al-Faruq (the discerner of truth from falsehood), Dhun-Nurayn (he of two lights) Uthman, the door to the City of Knowledge Imam Ali, and upon the Muhajirun (migrants), the Ansar (helpers) and all the Companions!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، حَنَّ لَكَ الجِذْعُ مِنْ أَلَمِ الفُرَاقِ، فَفَازَ مِنْكَ بِالعِنَاقِ، وَبِشَارَةِ المُرَافَقَةِ وَاللَّحَاقِ، وَهَا أَنَا أَحِنُّ إِلَيْكَ مُشْتَاقٌ إِلَيْكَ، وَاقِفٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ Rasûlallâh, hanna lakal-jidz`u min alamil-furâq, fafâza minka bil-`inâq, wa bisyâratil-murâfaqati wal-lahâq, wa hâ ana ahinnu ilayka musytâqun ilayk, wâqifun bayna yadayk.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Rasulullah! Batang kurma merintih karena pedihnya perpisahan denganmu, lalu ia beruntung mendapat pelukanmu serta kabar gembira akan menyertaimu dan menyusulmu. Dan inilah aku, merindukanmu, mendambakanmu, berdiri di hadapanmu.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, O my master, O Messenger of Allah! The palm-trunk ached with longing at being parted from you — and in return received your embrace, and the glad tidings that it would be with you in Paradise. And here I stand, longing for you, yearning for you, waiting in your presence.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar:
الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ، دَعَتْكَ لِنَجْدَتِهَا الغَزَالَةُ المَعْصُوبَةُ فَفَكَكْتَ قَيْدَهَا، وَرَحِمْتَ ضَعْفَهَا، وَرَحِمْتَهَا بِصِغَارِهَا، وَأَنَا المُقَيَّدُ بِذَنْبِي، المُكَبَّلُ بِعَيْبِي عَلَى عَتَبَاتِ بَابِكَ وَقَفْتُ.
كَمْ أَبْرَأَتْ وَصِبًا بِاللَّمْسِ رَاحَتُهُ * وَأَطْلَقَتْ أَرِبًا مِنْ رِبْقَةِ اللَّمَمِ
passages.tr:
Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh, da`atka linajdatihal-ghazâlatul-ma`shûbatu fafakakta qaydahâ, wa rahimta dha`fahâ, wa rahimtahâ bishighârihâ, wa anal-muqayyadu bidzanbî, al-mukabbalu bi`aybî `alâ `atabâti bâbika waqaft.
Kam abra'at washiban bil-lamsi râhatuhu * wa athlaqat ariban min ribqatil-lamami
passages.id_:
Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah! Seekor kijang yang terikat memanggilmu memohon pertolongan, lalu engkau lepaskan ikatannya, engkau kasihani kelemahannya, dan engkau sayangi anak-anaknya. Dan akulah yang terikat oleh dosaku, terbelenggu oleh aibku, berdiri di ambang pintumu.
Betapa sering telapak tangannya menyembuhkan yang sakit dengan sentuhan * dan membebaskan orang yang menderita dari jeratan kegilaan
passages.en:
Salutations and peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah! A gazelle, trapped and bound, called out to you to rescue it. So you unshackled its bonds, showed compassion for its weakness, and had mercy on its young. I, too, am bound — ensnared by my sins, shackled by my flaws — and here I stand at your doorstep.
How many times has the touch of his palm relieved the unwell * and freed the helpless from the noose of insanity.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ، جَاءَكَ كَعْبُ بْنُ زُهَيْرٍ بَعْدَ إِسَاءَتِهِ فِي حَقِّكَ، وَتَطَاوُلِهِ عَلَى مَقَامِكَ، فَقَابَلْتَهُ بِالأَمَانِ، فَأَنْشَدَكَ: (بَانَتْ سُعَادُ)، فَفَازَ بِالإِسْعَادِ، وَكَسَوْتَهُ بُرْدَتَكَ الشَّرِيفَةَ، وَهَا أَنَا ذَا جِئْتُكَ مُعْتَذِرًا عَنْ تَقْصِيرِي وَغَفْلَتِي، تَائِبًا مِنْ ذَنْبِي، أَرْجُو نَيْلَ الأَمَانِ، وَخِلْعَةَ الرِّضْوَانِ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh, jâ'aka Ka`bubnu Zuhayrin ba`da isâ'atihi fî haqqik, wa tathâwulihi `alâ maqâmik, faqâbaltahu bil-amân, fa'ansyadaka: (Bânat Su`âd), fafâza bil-is`âd, wa kasautahu burdatakasy-syarîfah, wa hâ ana dzâ ji'tuka mu`tadziran `an taqshîrî wa ghaflatî, tâ'iban min dzanbî, arjû naylal-amân, wa khil`atar-ridhwân.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah! Ka'b bin Zuhair datang kepadamu setelah berbuat buruk terhadap hakmu dan lancang terhadap kedudukanmu, lalu engkau sambut ia dengan jaminan keamanan; ia pun melantunkan untukmu kasidah 'Banat Su'ad', maka ia beruntung memperoleh kebahagiaan dan engkau kenakan padanya burdahmu yang mulia. Dan inilah aku datang kepadamu, memohon maaf atas kelalaian dan keteledoranku, bertobat dari dosaku, berharap meraih keamanan dan jubah keridhaan.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah! Ka'b bin Zuhayr came to you after having wronged you and after having disregarded your esteemed position, and you received him with amnesty. He recited his ode Banat Su'ad to you and was granted felicity, and you draped him in your noble mantle. And here I am, having come to you, apologising for my shortcomings and heedlessness, repentant of my sins, hoping to attain safety and be clothed in the mantle of your satisfaction.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ، مَا وَقَفَ عَلَى بَابِكَ جَائِعٌ إِلَّا أَطْعَمْتَهُ، وَلَا عُرْيَانٌ إِلَّا كَسَوْتَهُ، وَهَا أَنَا ذَا جَائِعٌ لِغِذَاءِ الأَرْوَاحِ، عُرْيَانٌ عَنْ خِلَعِ الفَتَّاحِ، فَلَا خِبْتُ وَأَنَا بِبَابِكَ نَازِلٌ، وَبِجَنَابِكَ لَائِذٌ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh, mâ waqafa `alâ bâbika jâ'i`un illâ ath`amtah, wa lâ `uryânun illâ kasautah, wa hâ ana dzâ jâ'i`un lighidzâ'il-arwâh, `uryânun `an khila`il-fattâh, falâ khibtu wa ana bibâbika nâzil, wa bijanâbika lâ'idz.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah! Tidak seorang lapar pun berdiri di pintumu melainkan engkau beri makan, dan tidak seorang telanjang pun melainkan engkau beri pakaian. Dan inilah aku, lapar akan santapan ruhani, telanjang dari jubah anugerah al-Fattah; maka tak mungkin aku kecewa sementara aku singgah di pintumu dan berlindung di sisimu.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah! No one ever came to your door hungry except that you fed them, and no one came unclothed except that you clothed them. Here I am — hungry for the nourishment of my soul, a naked soul in need of the garments bestowed by al-Fattah (the Opener). How could I ever be disappointed, when I have come to your door and sought shelter in your presence?

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ، جَاءَكَ البَعِيرُ يَشْكُو إِلَيْكَ، مُقَبِّلًا قَدَمَيْكَ، فَقَبِلْتَ شِكَايَتَهُ، وَتَوَلَّيْتَ رِعَايَتَهُ، فَكَيْفَ بِمَنْ هُوَ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ مُسْتَجِيبًا لِدَعْوَتِكَ؟! وَشِكَايَتِي: نَفْسِي وَغَفْلَتِي.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh, jâ'akal-ba`îru yasykû ilayk, muqabbilan qadamayk, faqabilta syikâyatah, wa tawallayta ri`âyatah, fakayfa biman huwa min ummatika mustajîban lida`watik?! Wa syikâyatî: nafsî wa ghaflatî.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah! Seekor unta datang mengadu kepadamu sambil mencium kedua kakimu, lalu engkau terima pengaduannya dan engkau urus pemeliharaannya; maka bagaimana pula dengan orang dari umatmu yang menyambut seruanmu?! Dan pengaduanku: diriku sendiri dan kelalaianku.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah! The camel came to you complaining, kissing your feet; you listened to its grievances and saw to its care. What, then, of one who belongs to your Ummah and has responded to your call? My complaint is my own self, and my heedlessness.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ، أَمَرَنَا رَبُّنَا إِذَا قَصَّرْنَا وَأَذْنَبْنَا وَعَصَيْنَا أَنْ نَأْتِيَ إِلَى بَابِكَ، وَنَنْزِلَ بِرِحَابِكَ، وَنَلُوذَ بِأَعْتَابِكَ، فَقَالَ تَعَالَى: ﴿وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ إِذ ظَّلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمْ جَآءُوكَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ لَوَجَدُواْ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابًا رَّحِيمًا﴾
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh, amaranâ rabbunâ idzâ qashsharnâ wa adznabnâ wa `ashaynâ an na'tiya ilâ bâbik, wa nanzila birihâbik, wa nalûdza bi'a`tâbik, faqâla ta`âlâ: wa lau annahum idz zhalamû anfusahum jâ'ûka fastaghfarullâha wastaghfara lahumur-rasûlu lawajadullâha tawwâban rahîmâ.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah! Tuhan kami memerintahkan kami, apabila kami lalai, berdosa, dan durhaka, untuk datang ke pintumu, singgah di pelataranmu, dan berlindung di ambang pintumu. Allah Ta'ala berfirman: "Dan sekiranya mereka, ketika menzalimi diri mereka sendiri, datang kepadamu lalu memohon ampunan kepada Allah, dan Rasul pun memohonkan ampunan untuk mereka, niscaya mereka mendapati Allah Maha Penerima tobat lagi Maha Penyayang." [Surah an-Nisa 4:64]
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah! Our Lord has commanded us that when we fall short, sin, and disobey, to come to your door, enter your welcoming presence, and seek refuge at your threshold. The Most High said: "And if they, when they have wronged their own souls, come to you and ask forgiveness of Allah, and the Messenger asks forgiveness for them, they would certainly find Allah Accepting of repentance, Most Merciful." [Surah an-Nisa 4:64]

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: وَهَا أَنَا بِذُنُوبِي وَخَطَايَايَ جِئْتُ تَائِبًا، مِنْ ذُنُوبِي هَارِبًا، فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِي رَبَّكَ التَّوَّابَ الرَّحِيمَ، حَتَّى لَا أَخْرُجَ إِلَّا وَوَجَدْتُ اللهَ وُجُودًا أَسْتَغْنِي بِهِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاهُ. فَأَيُّ شَيْءٍ فَقَدَ مَنْ وَجَدَ اللهَ؟ وَأَتُوبُ تَوْبَةً صَادِقَةً لَا نَكْثَ لِعَهْدِهَا، وَلَا خُلْفَ لِوَعْدِهَا.
passages.tr: Wa hâ ana bidzunûbî wa khathâyâya ji'tu tâ'ibâ, min dzunûbî hâribâ, fastaghfir lî rabbakat-tawwâbar-rahîm, hattâ lâ akhruja illâ wa wajadtullâha wujûdan astaghnî bihi `amman siwâh. Fa'ayyu syay'in faqada man wajadallâh? Wa atûbu taubatan shâdiqatan lâ naktsa li`ahdihâ, wa lâ khulfa liwa`dihâ.
passages.id_: Dan inilah aku, dengan segala dosa dan kesalahanku, datang bertobat, melarikan diri dari dosa-dosaku; maka mohonkanlah ampunan untukku kepada Tuhanmu Yang Maha Penerima tobat lagi Maha Penyayang, hingga aku tidak keluar kecuali telah menemukan Allah, suatu penemuan yang mencukupiku dari segala selain-Nya. Apalah yang hilang bagi orang yang telah menemukan Allah? Dan aku bertobat dengan tobat yang tulus, yang janjinya tak akan kuingkari dan ikrarnya tak akan kukhianati.
passages.en: And here I am, laden with sins and transgressions, coming in repentance, fleeing from my sins. So please ask forgiveness for me from your Lord, the Acceptor of Repentance, the Most Merciful, so that I do not leave without having found Allah — a finding that suffices me above all else. For what could one ever lack who has found Allah? And I repent sincerely, never to break my promise or go back on my word.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ، قَالَ رَبُّنَا فِيمَا بَلَّغْتَهُ لَنَا: ﴿وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُواْ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّئَاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ﴾ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ: (مِنْ عِبَادِهِ).. فَأَيْنَ تَصِلُ تَوْبَتِي، وَالصِّدْقُ عِنْدِي مَعْدُومٌ؟ فَتُبْ عَنَّا لِيَتُوبَ اللهُ عَلَيْنَا، فَقَدْ غَفَرَ اللهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh, qâla rabbunâ fîmâ ballaghtahu lanâ: wa huwal-ladzî yaqbalut-taubata `an `ibâdihi wa ya`fû `anis-sayyi'âti wa ya`lamu mâ taf`alûn. Wa lam yaqul: (min `ibâdih).. fa'ayna tashilu taubatî, wash-shidqu `indî ma`dûm? Fatub `annâ liyatûballâhu `alaynâ, faqad ghafarallâhu laka mâ taqaddama min dzanbika wa mâ ta'akhkhar.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah! Tuhan kami berfirman dalam apa yang engkau sampaikan kepada kami: "Dialah yang menerima tobat atas nama hamba-hamba-Nya dan memaafkan segala kesalahan, dan Dia mengetahui apa yang kamu kerjakan." [Surah asy-Syura 42:25] Dia tidak berfirman "dari hamba-hamba-Nya"... Maka sampai di mana tobatku dapat tiba, sedangkan kejujuran tiada padaku? Karena itu bertobatlah engkau atas nama kami agar Allah menerima tobat kami, karena sungguh Allah telah mengampuni bagimu dosamu yang terdahulu dan yang kemudian.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah! Our Lord has said, as you conveyed to us: "It is He who accepts repentance on behalf of His servants and pardons evil deeds. He knows everything you do." [Surah ash-Shura 42:25] He did not say "from His servants"... How far can my repentance even reach, when sincerity within me is utterly lacking? So repent on our behalf, that Allah may turn to us in mercy — for Allah has forgiven you your earlier and later sins.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ، قَالَ فِيكَ إِلَهُنَا العَظِيمُ: ﴿وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ﴾. وَقَدْ بَلَغَنَا عَنْكَ أَنَّ أَهْلَ المَعْرُوفِ فِي الدُّنْيَا هُمْ أَهْلُ المَعْرُوفِ فِي الآخِرَةِ؛ فَيَا سَيِّدَ أَهْلِ المَعْرُوفِ، جَاءَكَ الضُّيُوفُ، فَمُدَّ لَنَا شَرِيفَ السِّمَاطِ، وَحَبْلَ الِارْتِبَاطِ؛ لِنَسْلُكَ سَوَاءَ الصِّرَاطِ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh, qâla fîka ilâhunal-`azhîm: wa innaka la`alâ khuluqin `azhîm. Wa qad balaghanâ `anka anna ahlal-ma`rûfi fid-dunyâ hum ahlul-ma`rûfi fil-âkhirah; fayâ sayyida ahlil-ma`rûf, jâ'akadh-dhuyûf, famudda lanâ syarîfas-simâth, wa hablal-irtibâth; linasluka sawâ'ash-shirâth.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah! Tuhan kami Yang Maha Agung berfirman tentang dirimu: "Dan sesungguhnya engkau benar-benar berbudi pekerti yang agung." [Surah al-Qalam 68:4] Dan telah sampai kepada kami darimu bahwa ahli kebaikan di dunia adalah ahli kebaikan di akhirat; maka wahai penghulu ahli kebaikan, para tamu telah datang kepadamu — bentangkanlah bagi kami hidangan yang mulia dan tali ikatan denganmu, agar kami menempuh jalan yang lurus.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah! Our great God has said about you: "Indeed, you truly stand on an exalted standard of character." [Surah al-Qalam 68:4] We have learned from you that those who do good in this world are the people of good in the Hereafter. So, O master of all who do good, your guests have come to you — please spread for us the noble banquet and extend the rope of connection to you, that we may tread the straight path.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ، قَالَ فِيكَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ: ﴿وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ﴾. جِئْتُ طَالِبًا الرَّحْمَةَ، فَارْفَعِ الكَفَّ الشَّرِيفَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ اللَّطِيفِ، أَنْ يَرْحَمَنِي وَيَغْفِرَ لِي وَيَلْطُفَ بِي.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh, qâla fîkar-rahmânur-rahîm: wa mâ arsalnâka illâ rahmatan lil-`âlamîn. Ji'tu thâliban ar-rahmah, farfa`il-kaffasy-syarîfa ilâ rabbikal-lathîf, an yarhamanî wa yaghfira lî wa yalthufa bî.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah! Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim berfirman tentang dirimu: "Dan tiadalah Kami mengutusmu melainkan sebagai rahmat bagi semesta alam." [Surah al-Anbiya 21:107] Aku datang mencari rahmat, maka angkatlah tangan mulia itu kepada Tuhanmu Yang Maha Lembut, agar Dia merahmatiku, mengampuniku, dan berlemah lembut kepadaku.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah! The Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful has declared about you: "We sent you only as a mercy to all the worlds." [Surah al-Anbiya 21:107] I have come seeking mercy, so please raise your noble hand to your Gentle Lord, to have mercy on me, forgive me, and treat me gently.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ، قَالَ رَبُّنَا: ﴿إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾. وَهَا هِيَ يَدُ العَبْدِ الضَّعِيفِ بِعَهْدِ الوَلَاءِ وَالوَفَاءِ، فَرُوحِي وَنَفْسِي وَمَالِي لَكَ الفِدَاءُ، وَلِخِدْمَةِ دِينِكَ وَشَرْعِكَ الشَّرِيفِ وَسُنَّتِكَ المُنِيفَةِ. فَامْدُدْ لِي كَفَّ إِحْسَانِكَ، وَاقْبَلْنِي فِي جُمْلَةِ خُدَّامِكَ.
passages.tr: Ash-shalâtu was-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh, qâla rabbunâ: innal-ladzîna yubâyi`ûnaka innamâ yubâyi`ûnallâha yadullâhi fauqa aydîhim. Wa hâ hiya yadul-`abdidh-dha`îfi bi`ahdil-walâ'i wal-wafâ', farûhî wa nafsî wa mâlî lakal-fidâ', wa likhidmati dînika wa syar`ikasy-syarîfi wa sunnatikal-munîfah. Famdud lî kaffa ihsânik, waqbalnî fî jumlati khuddâmik.
passages.id_: Shalawat dan salam atasmu, wahai junjunganku, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah! Tuhan kami berfirman: "Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berbaiat kepadamu, sesungguhnya mereka berbaiat kepada Allah; tangan Allah di atas tangan mereka." [Surah al-Fath 48:10] Dan inilah tangan seorang hamba yang lemah dengan ikrar kesetiaan dan ketulusan; ruhku, jiwaku, dan hartaku menjadi tebusan bagimu, dan untuk berkhidmat kepada agamamu, syariatmu yang mulia, dan sunnahmu yang luhur. Maka ulurkanlah kepadaku tangan kebaikanmu, dan terimalah aku dalam barisan para pelayanmu.
passages.en: Salutations and peace be upon you, my master, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah! Our Lord has proclaimed: "Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you are actually pledging allegiance to Allah. The hand of Allah is over theirs." [Surah al-Fath 48:10] Here is the hand of this weak servant, pledging loyalty and faithfulness. May my soul, my life, and all that I have be sacrificed for you, and in service of your religion, your sacred law and your sublime sunnah. Please extend to me your generous hand and accept me among your servants.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar:
يَا سَيِّدِي يَا نَبِيَّ اللهِ، يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ، يَا حَبِيبَ اللهِ.
أَنْتَ بَابُ اللهِ نَالَ المُرْتَجَى * وَالأَمَانِي مَنْ عَلَيْهِ وَقَفَا
أَنْتَ حَبْلُ اللهِ مَنْ أَمْسَكَهُ * فَازَ بِالخَيْرِ وَبِالعَهْدِ وَفَا
passages.tr:
Yâ sayyidî yâ nabiyyallâh, yâ Rasûlallâh, yâ habîballâh.
Anta bâbullâhi nâlal-murtajâ * wal-amânî man `alayhi waqafâ
Anta hablullâhi man amsakahu * fâza bil-khayri wa bil-`ahdi wafâ
passages.id_:
Wahai junjunganku, wahai Nabi Allah, wahai Rasulullah, wahai kekasih Allah!
Engkaulah pintu Allah: siapa berhenti di hadapannya * akan meraih harapan dan segala cita-citanya
Engkaulah tali Allah: siapa berpegang padanya * beruntung memperoleh kebaikan dan setia pada ikrarnya
passages.en:
O my master, O Prophet of Allah, O Messenger of Allah, O Beloved of Allah!
You are the door of Allah: whoever stands before it * finds their hopes and wishes fulfilled
You are the rope of Allah: whoever holds onto it * gains every good and remains true to the covenant

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar:
أَلَا يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ إِنَّا قَرَابَةٌ * وَذُرِّيَّةٌ جِئْنَاكَ لِلشَّوْقِ وَالحُبِّ
وَقَفْنَا عَلَى أَعْتَابِ فَضْلِكَ سَيِّدِي * لِتَقْبِيلِ تُرْبٍ حَبَّذَا لَكَ مِنْ تُرْبِ
وَقُمْنَا تُجَاهَ الوَجْهِ وَجْهٌ مُبَارَكٌ * عَلَيْنَا بِهِ نُسْقَى الغَمَامُ لَدَى الجَدْبِ
أَتَيْنَاكَ زُوَّارًا نَرُومُ شَفَاعَةً * إِلَى اللهِ فِي مَحْوِ الإِسَاءَةِ وَالذَّنْبِ
passages.tr:
Alâ yâ Rasûlallâhi innâ qarâbatun * wa dzurriyyatun ji'nâka lisy-syauqi wal-hubbi
Waqafnâ `alâ a`tâbi fadhlika sayyidî * litaqbîli turbin habbadzâ laka min turbi
Wa qumnâ tujâhal-wajhi wajhun mubârakun * `alaynâ bihi nusqal-ghamâmu ladal-jadbi
Ataynâka zuwwâran narûmu syafâ`atan * ilallâhi fî mahwil-isâ'ati wadz-dzanbi
passages.id_:
Wahai Rasulullah, sesungguhnya kami kerabat * dan keturunanmu; kami datang karena rindu dan cinta
Kami berdiri di ambang pintu karuniamu, wahai junjunganku * untuk mencium tanah — alangkah mulianya tanah milikmu
Kami berdiri menghadap wajah itu, wajah yang penuh berkah * yang dengannya awan dimohonkan hujan bagi kami di musim kering
Kami datang kepadamu berziarah, mendambakan syafaat * di hadapan Allah demi terhapusnya kesalahan dan dosa
passages.en:
O Messenger of Allah, we are your own kin * and descendants; we have come to you in longing and in love
We stand at the threshold of your grace, my master * to kiss the dust — how fortunate we are to touch it
We stand before your face, a blessed face * through which the clouds are summoned to water parched land
We have come to you as visitors, seeking your intercession * with Allah to wipe away our misdeeds and sins

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar:
وُفُودٌ وَزُوَّارٌ وَأَضْيَافُ حَضْرَةٍ * مُكَرَّمَةٍ مُسْتَوْطَنِ الجُودِ وَالخَصْبِ
وَفِي النَّفْسِ حَاجَاتٌ وَثَمَّ مَطَالِبُ * تُؤَمِّلُ أَنْ تُقْضَى بِجَاهِكَ يَا مُحْبِي
تَوَجَّهْ رَسُولَ اللهِ فِي كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ * لَنَا وَمُهِمٍّ فِي المَعَاشِ وَفِي القَلْبِ
وَإِنَّ صَلَاحَ الدِّينِ وَالقَلْبِ سَيِّدِي * هُوَ الغَرَضُ الأَقْصَى فَيَا سَيِّدِي قُمْ بِي
passages.tr:
Wufûdun wa zuwwârun wa adhyâfu hadhratin * mukarramatin mustauthanil-jûdi wal-khashbi
Wa fin-nafsi hâjâtun wa tsamma mathâlibu * tu'ammilu an tuqdhâ bijâhika yâ muhbî
Tawajjah Rasûlallâhi fî kulli hâjatin * lanâ wa muhimmin fil-ma`âsyi wa fil-qalbi
Wa inna shalâhad-dîni wal-qalbi sayyidî * huwal-gharadhul-aqshâ fayâ sayyidî qum bî
passages.id_:
Kamilah para utusan, penziarah, dan tamu suatu hadirat * yang dimuliakan, tempat bersemayamnya kedermawanan dan kelimpahan
Dalam jiwa ada berbagai hajat, dan ada pula permohonan * yang diharapkan terkabul berkat kedudukanmu, wahai kekasihku
Menghadaplah kepada Allah, wahai Rasulullah, untuk setiap hajat * kami, dan setiap urusan penting dalam penghidupan dan hati
Sungguh, baiknya agama dan hati, wahai junjunganku * itulah tujuan tertinggi — maka wahai junjunganku, bangkitlah membelaku
passages.en:
We are envoys, visitors, and guests of an honoured presence * the dwelling-place of generosity and plenty
Within our souls are needs and requests * we hope will be fulfilled through your honour, O my beloved
Turn to Allah, O Messenger of Allah, for every need of ours * in all that concerns our livelihood and our hearts
For sound faith and a sound heart, my master * is the ultimate goal — so, O my master, take up my cause

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَوَّلِ مُتَلَقٍّ لِفَيْضِكَ الأَوَّلِ، وَأَكْرَمِ حَبِيبٍ تَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَيْهِ فَتَفَضَّلَ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَتَابِعِيهِ وَحِزْبِهِ، مَا دَامَ تَلَقِّيهِ مِنْكَ وَتَرَقِّيهِ إِلَيْكَ، وَإِقْبَالُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَإِقْبَالُهُ عَلَيْكَ، وَشُهُودُهُ لَكَ وَانْطِرَاحُهُ لَدَيْكَ، صَلَاةً نَشْهَدُكَ بِهَا مِنْ مِرْآتِهِ، وَنَصِلُ بِهَا إِلَى حَضْرَتِكَ مِنْ حَضْرَةِ ذَاتِهِ، قَائِمِينَ لَكَ وَلَهُ بِالأَدَبِ الوَافِرِ، مَغْمُورِينَ مِنْكَ وَمِنْهُ بِالمَدَدِ البَاطِنِ وَالظَّاهِرِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin awwali mutalaqqin lifaydhikal-awwal, wa akrami habîbin tafadhdhalta `alayhi fatafadhdhal, wa `alâ âlihi wa shahbihi wa tâbi`îhi wa hizbih, mâ dâma talaqqîhi minka wa taraqqîhi ilayk, wa iqbâluka `alayhi wa iqbâluhu `alayk, wa syuhûduhu laka wanthirâhuhu ladayk, shalâtan nasyhaduka bihâ min mir'âtih, wa nashilu bihâ ilâ hadhratika min hadhrati dzâtih, qâ'imîna laka wa lahu bil-adabil-wâfir, maghmûrîna minka wa minhu bil-madadil-bâthini wazh-zhâhir.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad — penerima pertama limpahan karunia-Mu yang pertama, kekasih termulia yang Engkau anugerahi karunia lalu beliau pun melimpahkan karunia — beserta keluarga, para sahabat, para pengikut dan golongan beliau, selama beliau terus menerima dari-Mu dan naik mendaki menuju-Mu, selama Engkau menghadap kepadanya dan beliau menghadap kepada-Mu, selama beliau menyaksikan-Mu dan merendahkan diri di hadapan-Mu; shalawat yang dengannya kami menyaksikan-Mu dari cermin dirinya, dan dengannya kami sampai ke hadirat-Mu dari hadirat zatnya, seraya berdiri di hadapan-Mu dan di hadapan beliau dengan adab yang sempurna, tenggelam dalam limpahan pertolongan lahir dan batin dari-Mu dan darinya.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow Your prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the first to receive Your primordial outpouring, the noblest beloved on whom You bestowed grace, and who in turn bestowed grace upon creation; and upon his Family, his Companions, his followers and those loyal to him — for as long as he receives from You and ascends to You, and You turn toward him and he turns toward You, and he witnesses You and humbly casts himself before You: prayers through which we witness You through his mirror and enter into Your presence by way of his, standing before You and him with the best etiquette, and enveloped, inwardly and outwardly, in the spiritual assistance that comes from You through him.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تَمُدُّ بِهَا جِسْمِي مِنْ جِسْمِهِ، وَقَلْبِي مِنْ قَلْبِهِ، وَرُوحِي مِنْ رُوحِهِ، وَسِرِّي مِنْ سِرِّهِ، وَعِلْمِي مِنْ عِلْمِهِ، وَعَمَلِي مِنْ عَمَلِهِ، وَخُلُقِي مِنْ خُلُقِهِ، وَنِيَّتِي مِنْ نِيَّتِهِ، وَوِجْهَتِي مِنْ وِجْهَتِهِ، وَقَصْدِي مِنْ قَصْدِهِ، وَتَعُودُ بَرَكَاتُهَا عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى أَهْلِي وَأَحْبَابِي وَأَصْحَابِي وَعَلَى أَهْلِ عَصْرِي، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ يَا نُورُ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin shalâtan tamuddu bihâ jismî min jismih, wa qalbî min qalbih, wa rûhî min rûhih, wa sirrî min sirrih, wa `ilmî min `ilmih, wa `amalî min `amalih, wa khuluqî min khuluqih, wa niyyatî min niyyatih, wa wijhatî min wijhatih, wa qashdî min qashdih, wa ta`ûdu barakâtuhâ `alayya wa `alâ ahlî wa ahbâbî wa ash-hâbî wa `alâ ahli `ashrî, wa `alâ âlihi wa sallim yâ Nûr.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad: shalawat yang dengannya Engkau aliri jasadku dari jasadnya, hatiku dari hatinya, ruhku dari ruhnya, sirku dari sirnya, ilmuku dari ilmunya, amalku dari amalnya, akhlakku dari akhlaknya, niatku dari niatnya, arah hadapku dari arah hadapnya, dan tujuanku dari tujuannya — dan semoga berkahnya kembali kepadaku, keluargaku, orang-orang tercintaku, para sahabatku, dan orang-orang sezamanku; dan limpahkanlah pula kepada keluarga beliau salam, wahai Cahaya!
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers upon our master Muhammad: prayers through which You nourish my body from his body, my heart from his heart, my soul from his soul, my innermost self from his innermost self, my knowledge from his knowledge, my deeds from his deeds, my character from his character, my intention from his intention, my heart's focus from his heart's focus, and my aspiration from his aspiration — and may their blessings return upon me, my family, my loved ones, my companions and the people of my time; and upon his Family, and grant peace, O Light!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ نُورِكَ السَّارِي، وَمَدَدِكَ الجَارِي، وَاجْمَعْنِي بِهِ فِي كُلِّ أَطْوَارِي، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ يَا نُورُ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin nûrikas-sârî, wa madadikal-jârî, wajma`nî bihi fî kulli athwârî, wa `alâ âlihi wa shahbihi yâ Nûr.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad — cahaya-Mu yang menjalar dan madad-Mu yang terus mengalir — dan pertemukanlah aku dengannya dalam segala keadaanku; beserta keluarga dan para sahabat beliau, wahai Cahaya!
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad — Your light which spreads, and Your assistance which flows throughout creation — and unite me with him in all my states; and upon his Family and Companions, O Light!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الأَكْوَانِ، الحَاضِرِ مَعَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ فِي كُلِّ زَمَانٍ وَمَكَانٍ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ فِي كُلِّ أَوَانٍ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadin sayyidil-akwân, al-hâdhiri ma`a man shallâ `alayhi fî kulli zamânin wa makân, wa `alâ âlihi wa shahbihi fî kulli awân.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, penghulu seluruh alam, yang hadir bersama siapa pun yang bershalawat kepadanya di setiap masa dan tempat, beserta keluarga dan para sahabat beliau di setiap waktu.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon our master Muhammad, the master of all creation, the one who is present with whoever sends prayers upon him in every time and place, and upon his Family and Companions, at all times.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الكَامِلِ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ، كَمَا لَا نِهَايَةَ لِكَمَالِكَ وَعَدَدَ كَمَالِهِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ sayyidinâ Muhammadinin-nabiyyil-kâmil, wa `alâ âlih, kamâ lâ nihâyata likamâlika wa `adada kamâlih.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sang Nabi yang sempurna, beserta keluarganya — sebagaimana kesempurnaan-Mu tiada berujung, dan sebanyak kesempurnaan beliau.
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers, peace, and blessings upon our master Muhammad, the perfect Prophet, and upon his Family, without end — as there is no end to Your perfection, and as numerous as his perfections.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَكْرَمْتَهُ بِرُؤْيَةِ وَجْهِكَ الكَرِيمِ، صَلَاةً وَسَلَامًا تُكْرِمُنِي بِهَا بِرُؤْيَةِ وَجْهِهِ، رُؤْيَةً تُوصِلُنِي لِرُؤْيَةِ وَجْهِكَ الكَرِيمِ؛ يَا كَرِيمُ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma shalli wa sallim `alâ `abdika wa rasûlika sayyidinâ Muhammadin kamâ akramtahu biru'yati wajhikal-karîm, shalâtan wa salâman tukrimunî bihâ biru'yati wajhih, ru'yatan tûshilunî liru'yati wajhikal-karîm; yâ Karîm.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, limpahkanlah shalawat dan salam kepada hamba dan utusan-Mu, junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad, sebagaimana Engkau muliakan beliau dengan memandang wajah-Mu Yang Mulia: shalawat dan salam yang dengannya Engkau muliakan aku dengan memandang wajah beliau — pandangan yang mengantarkanku kepada memandang wajah-Mu Yang Mulia, wahai Yang Maha Pemurah!
passages.en: O Allah, bestow prayers and peace upon Your servant and messenger, our master Muhammad, as You honoured him with the sight of Your noble countenance: prayers and peace by which You honour me with seeing his noble face — a seeing that leads me to the sight of Your noble countenance, O Most Generous!

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ وَنَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِحَقِّ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ أَنْ تَقْضِيَ حَوَايِجَنَا، وَتُصْلِحَ نِيَّاتِنَا، وَتُطَهِّرَ قُلُوبَنَا، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا مَغْفِرَةً عَامَّةً تَمْحُو بِهَا جَمِيعَ ذُنُوبِنَا.
passages.tr: Allâhumma innâ natawajjahu ilayka wa natawassalu ilayka bihaqqi nabiyyika Muhammadin nabiyyir-rahmati an taqdhiya hawâyijanâ, wa tushliha niyyâtinâ, wa tuthahhira qulûbanâ, wa an taghfira lanâ maghfiratan `âmmatan tamhû bihâ jamî`a dzunûbinâ.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, sesungguhnya kami menghadap kepada-Mu dan bertawasul kepada-Mu demi kedudukan Nabi-Mu Muhammad, nabi pembawa rahmat: agar Engkau tunaikan hajat-hajat kami, perbaiki niat-niat kami, sucikan hati kami, dan ampuni kami dengan ampunan menyeluruh yang menghapus seluruh dosa kami.
passages.en: O Allah, we turn to You and seek Your help through the merit of Your Prophet Muhammad, the Prophet of Mercy: that You fulfill our needs, set right our intentions, purify our hearts, and grant us comprehensive forgiveness that erases every one of our sins.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ﴿رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي ٱلْأٓخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ﴾
passages.tr: Allâhumma rabbanâ âtinâ fid-dunyâ hasanatan wa fil-âkhirati hasanatan wa qinâ `adzâban-nâr.
passages.id_: Ya Allah! "Ya Tuhan kami, anugerahkanlah kepada kami kebaikan di dunia dan kebaikan di akhirat, dan peliharalah kami dari siksa neraka." [Surah al-Baqarah 2:201]
passages.en: O Allah! "Our Lord! Grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire." [Surah al-Baqarah 2:201]

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأَبْرَارِ، ﴿رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ﴾
passages.tr: Allâhummaghfir lanâ dzunûbanâ wa kaffir `annâ sayyi'âtinâ wa tawaffanâ ma`al-abrâr. Rabbanâ wa âtinâ mâ wa`adtanâ `alâ rusulika wa lâ tukhzinâ yaumal-qiyâmah, innaka lâ tukhliful-mî`âd.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, ampunilah dosa-dosa kami, hapuskanlah kesalahan-kesalahan kami, dan wafatkanlah kami bersama orang-orang yang berbakti. "Ya Tuhan kami, berikanlah kepada kami apa yang telah Engkau janjikan kepada kami melalui para rasul-Mu, dan janganlah Engkau hinakan kami pada hari kiamat; sesungguhnya Engkau tidak pernah mengingkari janji." [Surah Ali Imran 3:194]
passages.en: O Allah, forgive our sins, wipe out our misdeeds, and let us die among the righteous. "Our Lord! Grant us what You have promised us through Your messengers, and do not put us to shame on the Day of Rising — for certainly You do not break Your promise." [Surah Al Imran 3:194]

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْزِلْ عَلَى أَرْضِ قَلْبِي مِنْ سَمَاءِ فَضْلِكَ مَاءَ رَحْمَةٍ تُبْهِجُ بِهِ رُوحِي، وَتُنْبِتُ البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، فَتُثْمِرُ الخُشُوعَ وَالأَدَبَ مَعَكَ وَمَعَ حَبِيبِكَ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma anzil `alâ ardhi qalbî min samâ'i fadhlika mâ'a rahmatin tubhiju bihi rûhî, wa tunbitul-birra wat-taqwâ, fatutsmirul-khusyû`a wal-adaba ma`aka wa ma`a habîbik.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, turunkanlah ke bumi hatiku, dari langit karunia-Mu, air rahmat yang menggembirakan ruhku dan menumbuhkan kebajikan serta ketakwaan, hingga berbuah kekhusyukan dan adab kepada-Mu dan kepada kekasih-Mu.
passages.en: O Allah, let the rain of Your mercy fall from the skies of Your grace onto the earth of my heart, bringing joy to my soul and nurturing righteousness and mindfulness of You within me, so that it blossoms into humility, reverence, and beautiful conduct with You and with Your beloved.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا كَمَالَ اليَقِينِ، وَتَمَامَ المَعْرِفَةِ، وَحَقِيقَةَ التَّوْحِيدِ، وَصِدْقَ المَحَبَّةِ، وَصَفَاءَ النِّيَّةِ، وَحُسْنَ القَصْدِ، وَقُوَّةَ الشُّهُودِ، وَسَعَادَةَ الدَّارَيْنِ، وَارْزُقْنَا العُبُودِيَّةَ المَحْضَةَ وَعَافِيَةَ الدَّارَيْنِ؛ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ فِي لُطْفٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ.
passages.tr: Allâhummarzuqnâ kamâlal-yaqîn, wa tamâmal-ma`rifah, wa haqîqatat-tauhîd, wa shidqal-mahabbah, wa shafâ'an-niyyah, wa husnal-qashd, wa quwwatasy-syuhûd, wa sa`âdatad-dârayn, warzuqnal-`ubûdiyyatal-mahdhata wa `âfiyatad-dârayn; yâ arhamar-râhimîna fî luthfin wa `âfiyah.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, karuniakanlah kepada kami keyakinan yang sempurna, makrifat yang paripurna, hakikat tauhid, cinta yang tulus, niat yang jernih, maksud yang baik, kekuatan musyahadah, dan kebahagiaan dunia akhirat; dan karuniakanlah kepada kami penghambaan yang murni serta keselamatan di dua negeri, wahai Yang Maha Penyayang di antara para penyayang, dalam kelembutan dan afiat.
passages.en: O Allah, grant us perfect certainty, complete knowledge of You, true realization of Your Oneness, genuine love, pure intentions, beautiful purpose, strong witnessing of You, and happiness in this world and the next. Grant us sincere servitude to You and well-being in both worlds, O Most Merciful of all who show mercy, with gentleness and well-being.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي الصِّدِّيقِيَّةَ العُظْمَى، وَالمَحْبُوبِيَّةَ الكُبْرَى، وَحَقِيقَةَ مَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَدَوَامَ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مَحْبُوبًا عِنْدَ حَبِيبِكَ، مَخْطُوبًا فِي حَضْرَتِهِ، مَنْظُورًا بِعَيْنِ عِنَايَتِهِ، حَاضِرًا مَعَهُ؛ فِي خَيْرٍ وَلُطْفٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ.
passages.tr: Allâhummarzuqnish-shiddîqiyyatal-`uzhmâ, wal-mahbûbiyyatal-kubrâ, wa haqîqata ma`rifatik, wa dawâma `âfiyatik, waj`alnî mahbûban `inda habîbik, makhthûban fî hadhratih, manzhûran bi`ayni `inâyatih, hâdhiran ma`ah; fî khayrin wa luthfin wa `âfiyah.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, karuniakanlah kepadaku maqam shiddiqiyyah yang teragung, kedudukan tercinta yang terbesar, hakikat makrifat kepada-Mu, dan afiat yang berkesinambungan; jadikanlah aku dicintai di sisi kekasih-Mu, disapa di hadiratnya, dipandang dengan mata perhatiannya, dan hadir bersamanya — dalam kebaikan, kelembutan, dan afiat.
passages.en: O Allah, grant me the highest station of truthfulness, the highest degree of being loved by You, the reality of knowing You, and perpetual well-being. Make me beloved to Your Beloved, addressed by him in his presence, gazed upon by his caring eyes, and present with him — in goodness, gentleness, and well-being.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْنِي مَحْضَ سُرُورٍ لِقَلْبِهِ الشَّرِيفِ؛ حَامِلًا لِرَايَتِهِ، مُبَلِّغًا لِدَعْوَتِهِ، مُحْيِيًا لِسُنَّتِهِ، نَاشِرًا لِدِينِهِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma waj`alnî mahdha surûrin liqalbihisy-syarîf; hâmilan lirâyatih, muballighan lida`watih, muhyiyan lisunnatih, nâsyiran lidînih.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, jadikanlah aku sumber kegembiraan yang murni bagi hati beliau yang mulia: pembawa panjinya, penyampai dakwahnya, penghidup sunnahnya, dan penyebar agamanya.
passages.en: O Allah, make me a source of pure joy for his noble heart: a bearer of his flag, one who conveys his call, a reviver of his sunnah, and a spreader of his religion.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْيِنِي عَلَى سُنَّتِهِ، وَأَمِتْنِي عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنِي فِي زُمْرَتِهِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma ahyinî `alâ sunnatih, wa amitnî `alâ millatih, wahsyurnî fî zumratih.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, hidupkanlah aku di atas sunnahnya, wafatkanlah aku di atas agamanya, dan kumpulkanlah aku dalam rombongannya.
passages.en: O Allah, let me live by his sunnah, die on his religion, and be resurrected in his company.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْنِي وَأَهْلِي وَأَوْلَادِي مِنْ أَوَّلِ مَنْ يَشْفَعُ فِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الشَّفَاعَةِ العُظْمَى، وَأَكْرِمْنَا بِالدُّخُولِ فِي ظِلِّ لِوَائِهِ المَعْقُودِ، وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ المَوْرُودَ، وَأَكْرِمْنَا بِجِوَارِهِ فِي فَرَادِيسِ الجِنَانِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma waj`alnî wa ahlî wa aulâdî min awwali man yasyfa`u fîhim yaumasy-syafâ`atil-`uzhmâ, wa akrimnâ bid-dukhûli fî zhilli liwâ'ihil-ma`qûd, wa auridnâ haudhahul-maurûd, wa akrimnâ bijiwârihi fî farâdîsil-jinân.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, jadikanlah aku, keluargaku, dan anak-anakku termasuk golongan pertama yang beliau beri syafaat pada hari Syafaat Agung; muliakanlah kami dengan masuk ke bawah naungan panjinya yang terikat, antarkanlah kami minum dari telaganya yang didatangi, dan muliakanlah kami dengan bertetangga dengannya di taman-taman Firdaus.
passages.en: O Allah, make me, my family and my children among the first for whom he intercedes on the Day of the Supreme Intercession. Honour us to enter under the shade of his tied banner, allow us to drink from his frequented Pool, and honour us by granting us nearness to him in Firdaws, the highest gardens of Paradise.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رِضْوَانَكَ الأَكْبَرَ، وَأَنْ تُرْضِيَ عَنِّي نَبِيَّكَ وَتُرْضِيَ عَنِّي وَالِدَيَّ وَأَرْحَامِي وَجِيرَانِي وَذَوِي الحُقُوقِ عَلَيَّ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma innî as'aluka ridhwânakal-akbar, wa an turdhiya `annî nabiyyaka wa turdhiya `annî wâlidayya wa arhâmî wa jîrânî wa dzawil-huqûqi `alayya.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, aku memohon kepada-Mu keridhaan-Mu yang terbesar, dan agar Engkau jadikan Nabi-Mu ridha kepadaku, serta Engkau jadikan kedua orang tuaku, kaum kerabatku, para tetanggaku, dan semua yang memiliki hak atasku ridha kepadaku.
passages.en: O Allah, I ask You for Your greatest good-pleasure, and that You make Your Prophet pleased with me, and make my parents, relatives, neighbours, and all who have rights over me pleased with me.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَارْحَمْ أُمَّةَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَفَرِّجْ كُرُوبَهُمْ، وَاجْمَعْ كَلِمَتَهُمْ، وَوَحِّدْ صَفَّهُمْ، وَانْصُرْهُمْ عَلَى عَدُوِّهِمْ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma warham ummata sayyidinâ Muhammad, wa farrij kurûbahum, wajma` kalimatahum, wa wahhid shaffahum, wanshurhum `alâ `aduwwihim.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, rahmatilah umat junjungan kami Nabi Muhammad; lapangkanlah kesusahan mereka, satukanlah kalimat mereka, rapatkanlah barisan mereka, dan tolonglah mereka atas musuh mereka.
passages.en: O Allah, have mercy on the nation of our master Muhammad. Relieve their distress, unite their word, unify their ranks, and grant them victory over their enemy.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِ مَرْضَاهُمْ، وَعَافِ مُبْتَلَاهُمْ، وَيَسِّرْ أُمُورَهُمْ، وَاشْرَحْ صُدُورَهُمْ، وَاهْدِ ضَالَّهُمْ، وَأَصْلِحْ فَاسِدَهُمْ، وَقَوِّمْ مُعْوَجَّهُمْ، وَرُدَّ غَائِبَهُمْ، وَارْحَمْ مَوْتَاهُمْ.
passages.tr: Allâhummasyfi mardhâhum, wa `âfi mubtalâhum, wa yassir umûrahum, wasyrah shudûrahum, wahdi dhâllahum, wa ashlih fâsidahum, wa qawwim mu`wajjahum, wa rudda ghâ'ibahum, warham mautâhum.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, sembuhkanlah yang sakit di antara mereka, berilah afiat kepada yang tertimpa cobaan, mudahkanlah urusan mereka, lapangkanlah dada mereka, tunjukilah yang tersesat di antara mereka, perbaikilah yang rusak, luruskanlah yang bengkok, kembalikanlah yang jauh dari mereka, dan rahmatilah orang-orang yang telah wafat di antara mereka.
passages.en: O Allah, heal those among them who are sick, grant well-being to the afflicted among them, ease what is difficult in their lives, open and expand their hearts, guide those who have lost their way, reform those who are corrupt, straighten those who are crooked, bring back those who are absent, and have mercy on their deceased.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ ذَلِكَ بِسِرِّ أَسْرَارِ الفَاتِحَةِ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma taqabbal dzâlika bisirri asrâril-Fâtihah.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, terimalah semua itu dengan rahasia dari segala rahasia surah al-Fatihah.
passages.en: O Allah, accept all of this by the profound secret of al-Fatihah.

passages.sub: Habib Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman as-Saqqaf's visit to the Greatest Beloved ﷺ
passages.id_: Salam kepada Khulafaur Rasyidin
passages.en: Greeting the Righteous Caliphs

passages.sub: Greeting the Righteous Caliphs
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدَنَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقُ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَبْدَ اللهِ العَتِيقُ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَفِيقَ رَسُولِ اللهِ فِي الشِّدَّةِ وَالضِّيقِ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَلِيفَةَ رَسُولِ اللهِ عَلَى التَّحْقِيقِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidanâ Abâ Bakrinish-shiddîq. As-salâmu `alayka yâ `Abdallâhil-`atîq. As-salâmu `alayka yâ rafîqa Rasûlillâhi fisy-syiddati wadh-dhîq. As-salâmu `alayka yâ khalîfata Rasûlillâhi `alat-tahqîq.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai junjungan kami Abu Bakar ash-Shiddiq. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai Abdullah al-Atiq. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai sahabat setia Rasulullah dalam kesukaran dan kesempitan. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai khalifah Rasulullah yang sejati.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, our master Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, the utterly truthful! Peace be upon you, O Abdullah al-Atiq! Peace be upon you, O companion of the Messenger of Allah in hardship and distress! Peace be upon you, O true Caliph of the Messenger of Allah!

passages.sub: Greeting the Righteous Caliphs
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا سَيِّدِي عُمَرُ بْنَ الخَطَّابِ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَاطِقًا بِالصَّوَابِ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَنْ وَافَقَ كَلَامُهُ الكِتَابَ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَهِيدَ المِحْرَابِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alayka yâ sayyidî `Umarabnal-Khaththâb. As-salâmu `alayka yâ nâthiqan bish-shawâb. As-salâmu `alayka yâ man wâfaqa kalâmuhul-kitâb. As-salâmu `alayka yâ syahîdal-mihrâb.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai junjunganku Umar bin al-Khattab. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai yang berbicara dengan kebenaran. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai yang ucapannya selaras dengan al-Kitab. Salam sejahtera atasmu, wahai syahid di mihrab.
passages.en: Peace be upon you, O my master Umar ibn al-Khattab! Peace be upon you, O speaker of the truth! Peace be upon you, O one whose speech aligns with the Book! Peace be upon you, O one martyred in the prayer niche!

passages.sub: Greeting the Righteous Caliphs
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمَا يَا وَزِيرَيْ رَسُولِ اللهِ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمَا وَعَلَى ذِي النُّورَيْنِ سَيِّدِنَا عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمَا وَعَلَى مَنِ اسْتَحْيَتْ مِنْهُ مَلَائِكَةُ الرَّحْمَٰنِ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykumâ yâ wazîray Rasûlillâh. As-salâmu `alaykumâ wa `alâ dzin-nûrayni sayyidinâ `Utsmânabni `Affân. As-salâmu `alaykumâ wa `alâ manistahyat minhu malâ'ikatur-rahmân.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian berdua, wahai dua wazir Rasulullah. Salam sejahtera atas kalian berdua dan atas sang pemilik dua cahaya, junjungan kami Utsman bin Affan. Salam sejahtera atas kalian berdua dan atas dia yang para malaikat Ar-Rahman merasa malu kepadanya.
passages.en: Peace be upon you both, O ministers of the Messenger of Allah! Peace be upon you both, and upon the one blessed with the two lights, Dhun-Nurayn, our master Uthman ibn Affan! Peace be upon you both, and upon the one before whom the angels of the All-Merciful felt shy!

passages.sub: Greeting the Righteous Caliphs
passages.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمَا وَعَلَى سَيِّدِنَا الكَرَّارِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمَا وَعَلَى لَيْثِ بَنِي غَالِبٍ. السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمَا وَعَلَى بَابِ مَدِينَةِ العِلْمِ لِكُلِّ رَاغِبٍ.
passages.tr: As-salâmu `alaykumâ wa `alâ sayyidinal-karrâri `Aliyyibni Abî Thâlib. As-salâmu `alaykumâ wa `alâ laytsi banî Ghâlib. As-salâmu `alaykumâ wa `alâ bâbi madînatil-`ilmi likulli râghib.
passages.id_: Salam sejahtera atas kalian berdua dan atas junjungan kami al-Karrar, Ali bin Abi Thalib. Salam sejahtera atas kalian berdua dan atas singa Bani Ghalib. Salam sejahtera atas kalian berdua dan atas pintu kota ilmu bagi setiap pencari.
passages.en: Peace be upon you both, and upon our master al-Karrar (the valiant one who never retreats), Ali bin Abi Talib! Peace be upon you both, and upon the lion of Bani Ghalib! Peace be upon you both, and upon the Door to the City of Knowledge for every seeker!

passages.sub: Greeting the Righteous Caliphs
passages.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّهِمْ عَلَيْكَ، وَبِاصْطِفَائِكَ لَهُمْ لِصُحْبَةِ حَبِيبِكَ، وَمَا أَوْدَعْتَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ الكَامِلِ وَالتَّصْدِيقِ الكَامِلِ وَالمَحَبَّةِ الصَّادِقَةِ؛ أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُحَقِّقَ لِي وَفِيَّ كُلَّ ذَلِكَ فِي خَيْرٍ وَلُطْفٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ، وَتَقْبَلَ مِنِّي الزِّيَارَةَ، وَتُعَجِّلَ لِي بِالبِشَارَةِ... بِسِرِّ الفَاتِحَةِ وَإِلَى حَضْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
passages.tr: Allâhumma bihaqqihim `alayk, wa bishthifâ'ika lahum lishuhbati habîbik, wa mâ auda`ta fî qulûbihim minal-îmânil-kâmili wat-tashdîqil-kâmili wal-mahabbatish-shâdiqah; as'aluka an tuhaqqiqa lî wa fiyya kulla dzâlika fî khayrin wa luthfin wa `âfiyah, wa taqbala minniz-ziyârah, wa tu`ajjila lî bil-bisyârah... bisirril-Fâtihati wa ilâ hadhratin-nabiyyi shallallâhu `alayhi wa âlihi wa shahbihi wa sallam.
passages.id_: Ya Allah, demi hak mereka di sisi-Mu, demi pilihan-Mu atas mereka untuk menemani kekasih-Mu, dan demi iman yang sempurna, pembenaran yang sempurna, serta cinta yang tulus yang Engkau titipkan dalam hati mereka: aku memohon kepada-Mu agar Engkau wujudkan semua itu bagiku dan dalam diriku, dalam kebaikan, kelembutan, dan afiat; terimalah ziarahku, dan segerakanlah kabar gembira bagiku... dengan rahasia surah al-Fatihah, dihaturkan ke hadirat Nabi ﷺ beserta keluarga dan para sahabat beliau.
passages.en: O Allah, on account of their standing with You, Your divine selection of them for the companionship of Your Beloved, and the perfect faith, complete conviction, and genuine love You instilled in their hearts: I ask You to actualize and manifest all of that in me, in the best of ways, with gentleness and well-being; accept my visit, and bless me with good news soon... by the secret of al-Fatihah, offered to the presence of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, his Family and his Companions.
